output_list.criticism: The function 'settlement()' can be called arbitrarily by any address, resulting in a potential Token Split vulnerability. If one address holds all the tokens, this vulnerability allows an attacker to split tokens among other addresses with their share. A hacker could put all the tokens in his own account, sell those tokens, and split those tokens among his friends. Each friend now gets a few tokens. An attacker could buy tokens at high prices and sell it out repeatedly. This mechanism is totally worthless, causing minimal cost for the attacker. This function is very profitable.
